episodes.title: What You Don't Know About Russell Brand... | 2 Angry Men
episodes.description:
Harvey Levin and Mark Geragos break down Russell Brand’s conviction on one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault. They examine the pattern of conduct prosecutors presented, Brand’s media interviews and the impact of the BBC documentary, the judge’s role, and whether the intense publicity affected his right to a fair trial. They also discuss Brand’s courtroom appearance — from his unbuttoned shirts to the Bible he carried — and why presentation can matter to a jury. Plus, what Brand’s remand into custody could mean for his sentence Monday, with the judge warning he faces significant prison time.
